text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is coming to a close.
Wonder Acute
has used her time here
well and made amazing
progress. And
now, on the last day...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh... Oh my...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In her hand, she's holding the last thing I
ever
expected to see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, goodness no. This is Tarumae's
phone.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute really wanted to watch a video of
Falco
racing, so I'm letting her borrow it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is the Oi Teio Sho from back in
June.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. She really dominated that
race.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That breakaway speed is enough to turn your blood cold. No one could even reach her shadow.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... My goodness! Falco really is
impressive,
isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, that's a given. But look at
this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute holds out the phone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This one goes out to all the people out
there
cheering for me! I couldn't have
won without your
support! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was your cheers, applause, and
feelings that
pushed me forward there at
the head of the pack.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a lonely road in the front! But it
doesn't feel
that way when I have all of
you with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll be back for Tokyo Daishoten right
here in Oi
at the end of the year! You
better not miss it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's send this year off with a spectacle
that all of
us who love dirt racing will
never forget! ☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falco! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falco! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Listen to those chants. Not only does she
have an
edge on the track, but she also
has a massive
cheer squad behind her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's almost enough to make you wanna
give up...
These "Umagols" are a force to
be reckoned with.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's pronounced "Umadol"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae jumps in to correct her
without
missing a beat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Between the students at her father's
boxing gym
and the elderly people
doing physical therapy at
the hospital...
There are many people who want
to see
her succeed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe, but they can't come watch my
races in
person.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Especially the elderly folk. It'll be hard
to get
them to the track unless I can pile
up some
victories and add a bit of pep
to their steps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She makes a good point. There are some
hurdles
involved in visiting a racecourse
for the better
part of Wonder Acute's
supporters.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up so easily, Acute! I'm part
of your
cheer squad too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If you run in the Tokyo Daishoten, I'll
support you
with my feng shui cheers! ♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right. It does me a lot of
good having
you two cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Right, Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Eh? Um, well... I, uh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you're up against Falco, then I'm not
sure... I
mean, she's the Umamusume I
respect most of all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry, but I can't bring myself
to cheer
for her rival...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see...
Well, Trainer, it seems
having supporters can be a
very
powerful thing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that their power is
crucial to
finding success. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Falco! Falco!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fighting against the overwhelming
power that
Falco has at her back might
be a tall order
indeed. Hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fans wish for their favorites to win it all.
And the
culmination of such passion has
given rise to
numerous miracles in the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a major showdown on the horizon...
I want
an extra edge—some tailwind
behind Wonder
Acute's sails.
